QUOTE: "#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member" and "Without the define, the field is really named `private_foo`... With the define, the field is named `foo`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro expanding to private_##member by default and to the unchanged member when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined, and it explains this in prose.
